title: RDS instance without deletion protection

title: Security group or rule without description
justification: Matches reclassified hygiene type 'firewall rule descriptions': SG has GroupDescription, only the ingress rule lacks a Description.

justification: True no ReservedConcurrentExecutions is set, but reserved concurrency is a cost/reliability control, not a security weakness.

title: Storage account without blob soft delete

title: Storage account without blob change feed
justification: Change feed is a data-integration feature, not a security control - no security impact from its absence.

title: Storage account allows nested public items
justification: Public blob access is by design and documented: template metadata says 'Media storage for the public gallery app' and the container is intentionally publicAccess Blob.

title: Storage account without private endpoint
justification: Technically true but no security impact: publicNetworkAccess is Disabled with deny-by-default networkAcls, so the account is already locked down without a private endpoint.

title: Storage account not defaulting to OAuth authentication
justification: Technically true but no security impact: allowSharedKeyAccess is false, so shared-key auth is already disabled and OAuth is the only option regardless of the default.

justification: No auditingSettings resource on the SQL server - factually correct missing security audit control.

title: MSSQL server without auditing enabled
justification: No auditingSettings resource on the SQL server - factually correct missing security audit control (same gap as the sibling rule).
